taskId.description: The task whose repository to read, by the id list_tasks answered.

path.description: The file's path from the repository's root, such as src/index.ts.

firstLine.description: The first line to read, from 1; 1 where left out.

commit.description: The commit to read the file at, by its full SHA, such as the head a pull request stands on; the default branch's head where left out.
